Fairness for all road users is limited because the median barrier and grade-separated road design strongly prioritize through motor traffic, while walking routes appear secondary and less directly connected.

sustainability: Sustainability benefits from the substantial roadside greenery, including mature trees on the right and planted medians under the viaduct, which contribute to urban greening.

walkability: Walkability is constrained because the visible pedestrian route is confined to one side of a major road corridor and there is no visible crosswalk, refuge island, or signalized pedestrian crossing in the image.
